'Justice Knight' is a Raythean Exister-S1044 Model four-wheeled operation platform customized by a Kazimierzian engineer, later remodeled and upgraded by Mayer and Closure. Owing to its main searchlight function lacking use value, and its cover fire capacity being limited in its target market, its production has been halted. Before the Rhodes Island Engineering Department got their hands on her, 'Justice Knight' had already gone through a dozen modifications, big and small; her present capabilities are easily a far cry from the original model. Her old operating system and command memory data were damaged, unable to be recovered. After a swap for new core hardware and an expanded memory unit, an updated operating system plus additional artificial voice system, she is now hardly distinguishable from Raythean Industries's latest operation platforms. 'Justice Knight' is a member of Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub, and is currently authorized for use by Rhodes Island.=“正义骑士号”是由卡西米尔工程师客制化后的雷神存在者S-1044四轮作业平台，后由梅尔与可露希尔进行改造和升级。其原型产品由于主要提供的探照功能缺少使用价值，援护射击功能市场受众范围小，现已停产。在罗德岛工程部经手前，“正义骑士号”已经历过大大小小十余次的改造，现功能与原型可以说相去甚远。旧版操作系统与指令存储数据已完全损坏，无法找回。在更换了核心硬件设备、扩充存储装置、更新操作系统、添加人工语音系统之后，现与雷神工业新版作业平台性能相差无几。“正义骑士号”原为红松骑士团成员，目前授权给罗德岛使用。

<Nocturnal Tales>=《夜话》
<Nocturnal Tales>, from the collection of the Pu family in Mangshan, contains <Lives of Travelers>. It is an account of people who have encountered the paranormal while traveling at night, depicting a hundred different types of geists and spirits. Its text is obscure and absurd, and the government has banned it for being deceptive and misleading.\n<@lv.item><Condition></> Natural DP regeneration rate is reduced\n<@lv.item><Writing knife></> Can be used to move words\n<@lv.item><Glyph Tile></> Periodically drops Stamps, dealing True damage to both allies and enemies, and triggering any corresponding word effects=《夜话》一卷，邙山镇蒲氏家藏本。收《游人列传》，专述古人夜游寻仙、幽径逢鬼之事，兼录百种伥怪形迹。语近荒诞，文意晦涩，以其虚妄惑人，为官方禁绝。\n<@lv.item><特殊条件></>部署费用自然回复速度降低\n<@lv.item><书刀></>可以调整字的位置\n<@lv.item><字格></>一定间隔后落下活字印章，对敌我造成真实伤害，若有字则产生对应效果
<Nocturnal Tales>, from the collection of the Pu family in Mangshan, contains <Lives of Travelers>. It is an account of people who have encountered the paranormal while traveling at night, depicting a hundred different types of geists and spirits. <Of Willow and War>=《杨柳见闻》
<Of Willow and War> was submitted by the commander of Yumen. It was written by a common soldier, believed to be originally from Baizao, depicting the events that occurred on the frontier over the tenure of three commanders. The writing is fluent and the depictions realistic, but the names of the commanders are not mentioned in the book, making its veracity impossible to verify—a lamentable gap for later generations.\n<@lv.item><Condition></> Natural DP regeneration rate is reduced\n<@lv.item><Writing knife></> Can be used to move words\n<@lv.item><Glyph Tile></> Periodically drops Stamps, dealing True damage to both allies and enemies, and triggering any corresponding word effects=《杨柳见闻》一卷，玉门守将采进本。撰者系行伍小卒，考其生平，或为百灶籍人。载三将戍边事，文笔流畅，纪事近实。然彼三将之名，未录于书。致使稽考无凭，诚为后世之憾。\n<@lv.item><特殊条件></>部署费用自然回复速度降低\n<@lv.item><书刀></>可以调整字的位置\n<@lv.item><字格></>一定间隔后落下活字印章，对敌我造成真实伤害，若有字则产生对应效果

[Gloria and Nightmare]\nIt is not unusual for Oripathy to cause Multiple Personality Disorder, but Gloria, who is currently on a conservative treatment plan, is different from other Operators in stable condition. Her condition has a major hurdle: In moments where Gloria loses control, the very aggressive Nightmare takes over.\nHowever, studies have indicated that Nightmare is the dominant personality and is very much awake inside Gloria. They have even seen Nightmare trying to regain control over her body.\nThe medical team was unable to assimilate Gloria and Nightmare into one personality despite counseling. Should we continue to let her work for Rhodes Island when she still has Nightmare? A doctor will have to develop a relationship with Gloria before we can make that decision.\nNote: Dr. Kal'tsit made this statement about Gloria:\n'Integrating her personalities is her only option.'\nHowever, she did not specify which personality would become dominant after assimilation.=【葛罗莉亚与夜魔】\n目前可以得知，矿石病引发的多重人格障碍并非罕见病历，但目前以保守治疗方案进行医治的葛罗莉亚，与保持病情稳定的其他干员不同，她的病情似乎进入了一个困境：“夜魔”这一人格仍在缺乏控制的状态下忽然出现，剥夺主人格对身体的控制权，并显示出充满攻击型的姿态。\n然而有部分案例显示，“夜魔”人格作为主人格时，葛罗莉亚的主人格仍处于清醒状态，甚至有试图夺回对身体的控制权的情形发生。\n根据医疗组提供的报告显示，目前葛罗莉亚的衍生人格“夜魔”经多次心理干预后仍无法与主人格整合为一。是否在保留“夜魔”人格的前提下，继续允许其作为干员于罗德岛任职？这需要博士与葛罗莉亚建立联系后，才能做出决定。\n备注：针对葛罗莉亚的情况，凯尔希医生曾发表如下评论：\n“人格的整合是她的唯一选择”。\n不过凯尔希医生并未明确指出，究竟是哪一个人格会成为整合主导者。
[Gloria's Arts and Staff]\nBecause of her studies on the medical application of Originium and her experiences as an infected, she can use medical arts to heal her teammates while also adept at combat arts. Her ability to do many types of arts is the basis for her role at Rhodes Island.\nAccording to Gloria's own account, the staff her father left her has its own power. A number of tests done by warlock Operators has found the staff can increase the effectiveness of healing arts, but they must be performed in a manner similar to hypnosis. Feedback from test subjects also indicated they almost always dreamed in this hypnotized state. According to observation, the subjects quickly entered REM state, but did not experience other aspects of a normal sleep cycle. They remained in this state until awakened.=【葛罗莉亚的法术与法杖】\n基于成为感染者前研修医学源石技艺的经验，葛罗莉亚在作为术师干员的同时可以同时运用医疗法术，为身边的干员进行及时的急救行为。而在攻击型法术的施展方面，葛罗莉亚亦有不俗表现。她所展现出的法术多面性才能，是罗德岛得以吸收其作为干员的重要依据。\n根据干员葛罗莉亚的自述，由其父留下的法杖似乎本身亦具备一定的法术效能。经术师干员组多项测试可以发现，这柄法杖在某些方面拥有增幅治疗类法术的特殊效能，但必须以类似催眠式治疗法的方式施行。经受测试对象的反馈的分析结果显示，他们的睡眠几乎都在做梦。针对受测试对象的体征观察数据表明，所有受测对象均迅速进入了眼动期睡眠状态，而缺乏长时间的，无梦状态下的非眼动期睡眠（正常的睡眠周期是，睡眠将在眼动期——非眼动期睡眠状态中不断交替），并保持此状态直至被人唤醒。
[Gloria's Background]\nGloria was born in a small, artsy city in Victoria. Her mother worked at the local hospital. Gloria did not show interest in Originium until middle school. Although she has shown a unique talent for it in her tests at Rhodes Island, she still does not want to deal with it.\nGloria worked hard to become a medical student, either due to her mother's expectation or her own desire. However, her infection disrupted her future plans. Today, Gloria is still unable to recall how she got infected (it is worth noting her sessions all alluded to an alternate personality, 'Nightmare,' and it seemed only 'Nightmare' could recall how it happened). Temporary memory loss is a common symptom of Oripathy, so all investigations should take that into account.\nAccording to our intel, Gloria had at least six months of combat experience before joining Rhodes Island. Her militant 'Nightmare' personality seems to be the one behind the stint.=【葛罗莉亚的经历】\n葛罗莉亚出身于维多利亚一座充满艺术气息的小型城市，其母在当地某公立医院任职。直到中学时葛罗莉亚也并未展现出对源石技艺有多少热情。尽管她在罗德岛为其安排的多项测试展现出了别具一格的天赋，但她依然不愿正视这一点。\n无论是母亲对她的期望，还是葛罗莉亚出于自身的愿望，都朝向成为一名医科学生的方向而努力着。然而感染者危机的到来中断了她对将来的一切期盼。时至今日，葛罗莉亚仍无法有效回忆起自己成为感染者的经过（ 值得注意的是，她所有的自白话语均指向她那被称为“夜魔”的人格——似乎只有这个人格才清楚这一切究竟是如何发生的）。作为矿石病所引发的暂时性记忆损失，目前被认为是感染者病症过程中常见的一环，因此对葛罗莉亚的调查需基于她的病情稳定情况。\n根据相关情报显示，葛罗莉亚在加入罗德岛前，至少已具备了半年左右的战斗经验。对于这段战斗经历的解释，似乎仍要集中在好战的“夜魔”人格所影响。
[Gloria]\nAttempting to analyze Gloria is a long and difficult process ('Gloria,'her real name, is used in this report at her own request). In many therapy sessions, she clearly felt anxiety and panic, refusing to answer any questions in one session, leaving communication at a standstill. Using flowers and aromatherapy to relax her has been extremely effective thus far. [Originium Arts Overview]\nCh'en has never been seen using Originium Arts, which led many to suspect she didn't have a talent for it. Indeed, she did struggle to control her abilities, blasting the occasional hole in a wall, blowing files everywhere, and causing more collateral damage than might otherwise be acceptable. Using Originium Arts for too long tires her out. After discussion with the tech staff, it was decided Ch'en lacked the necessary conduit to control her Arts. Without one, Ch'en could never master it.\n\nI saw her test results. The thinner the staff, the better she is at assimilation. But what's the point? Maybe if you had something shaped like a sword, it might work for her. But who would want to use it for that? A sword is for slashing! We're going to need a lot more work on this..\n--Caster D=【源石技艺概览】\n陈从来不在人前使用源石技艺，这使得大多数人都认为陈不善此道。事实上，她确实在掌控源石技艺方面表现得相当糟糕，包括且不限于造成法杖的突然损坏、防爆墙的粉碎、气浪吹飞所有纸质档案，以及一系列对实验外对象的不必要的损害。施放源石技艺后，似乎是一次性动用了太多体力的缘故，陈长官本人也会陷入疲劳状态。至少术师干员们在讨论之后都认为，陈缺乏一个良好的媒介以掌控自己的源石技艺：在缺乏可利用装备的情况下，她就是没法将自己的源石技艺凝聚成型。\n\n我看了测试结果，法杖的形状越薄越锐，她越能适应；比起塑造新的客体，她更擅长催化法杖蕴含的源石本身。没用啊！如果能有把剑形法杖的话，可能会很适合她吧。不过谁会用那种东西啊，束手束脚的……剑不就是用来砍人的！多此一举啦。\n——术师干员D
[Originium Arts Overview]\nOperator Leonhardt's Originium Arts are not outstanding in terms of destructive power. He employs a simple directional shockwave, the strength of the impact roughly equivalent to that of an adult's punch. However during an examination, Leonhardt was able to demonstrate the process of breaking a boulder into pieces. It is worth noting that the boulder was infused with low-impurity minerals that had well-preserved structures akin to having gone through beneficiation. We speculate that this is among the reasons why he is highly sought after by mining companies. After analyzing data gathered by our equipment, we determined the Leonhardt was able to skillfully use his Arts to locate and finely separate the structure of the same kind of sand or metal within a range, accomplishing this by attacking the particles with high-speed bursts of debris.=【源石技艺概览】\n干员莱恩哈特所使用的源石技艺就其本身的破坏力而言并不算出众。这只是一种简单的定向冲击法术，其冲击力本身可能仅相当于成年人出拳的力度。 但在测试项目中，莱恩哈特甚至实际演示了将一块巨石破坏得粉碎的过程。值得注意的是，巨石中夹杂着一些杂质含量低的矿物，而它们保存了完好的结构，就像经历过选矿后的结果一般，推测这也许亦是总有矿业公司试图拉拢他的原因之一。辅以仪器所记录的数据分析可推断，他似乎能够巧妙运用源石技艺定位并精细地施力分离一定范围内同种砂土或金属的结构，利用高速迸发的碎片进行攻击。

Next, be flexible, adapt, keep switching up your position, and never panic no matter the jam you're in. Lastly, no putting music on during the hunt, but you can hum a tune to lift your teammates' spirits.=四月有她自己的一套丛林生存法则。首先判断时机，看好风向，隐藏好气息，永远当先出手的那一方；然后灵活应变，随时更换阵地，无论遇到怎样的困境绝不慌张；最后，狩猎过程中不可以听歌，但可以哼首小调让队友放松心情。

Aurora knows the feeling of the cold like nobody else, to the point she can continue to work completely unaffected in low temperatures the typical person could never even bear. This ability that sets her apart is hardly natural-born; it's something she's gained from time after time spent striving, training—if one day she wants to be able to protect her own home, protect Kjerag, then she can't fall short in any place that might ever need her. Bibeak has recently been asking operators with pets if their pet had escaped or gotten lost, as she has been finding small scratch marks on her door. She is usually so immersed in her design and tailor work that she does not hear sounds coming from outside the door, and would feel guilty if she failed to notice someone's stray pet trying to seek her help.\nNone of the operators reported anything unusual with their pets, but the scratch marks kept increasing by the day, until—\nShe put the bowtie on Miss.Christine's neck. Miss.Christine took a few satisfied spins in front of the mirror, made a heart shape with her twin tails, and left elegantly. The scratch marks stopped from that day forth.\nIt turns out that the scratches were not from a stray pet, but from a Miss.Christine who could not wait to see her newest attire.=柏喙最近一直在向各位养了宠物的干员询问，是否有发生宠物出逃或者迷路的事情。因为她在自己的房门上发现了许多小小的抓痕，而她平时因为沉浸在设计和制作衣服中，不怎么能听到门外传来的声音，如果是谁的小宠因为找不到家向她求助而她却没能及时发现，那她会感到十分愧疚。\n但令柏喙感到奇怪的是，养宠物的干员都说没有发生什么走丢的情况，但她门上的小抓痕却在一日日地增加。直到那一天——\n她把终于做好的领结戴在Miss.Christine的脖子上，看着女士很是满意地对着镜子转了几圈，然后对她用双尾比了一个心，优雅地离开了。从这天开始，柏喙再也没有发现新增的抓痕。\n所以说，其实那些小抓痕不是什么走丢的小宠求助，而是女士着急想穿新衣服的催促？
Bibeak heads through the long hallway and goes outside. It is a beautiful day. She looks at the clear skies and exhales.=柏喙往门外走，走出那条长长的走廊。 外面阳光很亮。她看着天空，呼出一口气。

Bibeak's swordsmanship master once cautioned her that, when flustered, she must be firmer than ever and focus her attention on both the tip of her sword and her enemy to land the decisive blow at her foe's moment of weakness. Bibeak thinks her hobby, sewing, has many similarities to swordsmanship. Both require the same level of attentiveness, and the thinking that one requires can help her further understand the other. Blitz is quite the 'jovial' person, having a penchant for laughing, a keen wit about him, and a striking ability to take the edge off the mood by way of a joke. Certain personnel tend to describe his sense of humor as 'goofy', though we consider it generally indicative of an optimistic, forward-looking nature. His conduct during combat, vigorous and unparalyzed by fear of survival, only serves to affirm this.\nDue to the similarities between their armaments, there are frequent discussions between Blitz and Liskarm. Through these exchanges, Blitz has become aware of one thing: his tactical light shield can't be restored to its original condition anymore.=闪击是一个“欢乐”的人，他爱笑，脑子转得快，也十分擅长讲些玩笑话来缓和气氛，有些人将他的这种幽默感定义为“犯傻”，但我们将其视作一种乐观向上的生活态度，而闪击在战斗时积极且不畏生死的战斗风格，也无疑佐证了这一点。\n因为武器上有相近之处，闪击与雷蛇的交流十分频繁，也正是通过这种交流，闪击了解到了一件事：自己的战术闪光护盾已经无法修复至原样了。

Candles have been used as light sources since ancient Yan, the carriers of fire, and are important tools in the Sui Regulator's rites. Zuo Le lights a candle, and directs everyone's attention to its flame. The wispy smoke is faint, while the flame is steady, detaching the mind from the body and allowing one to sense outside influences upon their souls. With this preparation, they will retain their sense of self when taking on the name of Sui and ascending into the sky.=烛是大炎自古以来传承至今的照明工具，是火的载体，也是司岁台行仪的重要器具。左乐点燃蜡烛，引导众人将注意力集中于烛火。轻烟缥缈，烛火定静，超脱心神于躯壳，有感外物于魂魄。有了这份准备，他们便可在代以岁名、扶摇直上时维持住自己的感知。

Cantabile=晓歌
Cantabile taught me to read some of the words in the book today. 'The warm soil uplifts the mist, the branches trace light's brows, and fowlbeasts sing in the dawnlight.' I wanted to know where I could find a place like this, so I asked her... But she went quiet on me. Maybe... it's just someone's imagination.=晓歌小姐今天教我认了书上的字。“温暖的泥土托起雾气，枝桠描摹光的眉目，羽兽在清晨歌唱。”我想知道哪里会有这种风景，就问了晓歌小姐，她却陷入了沉默……也许这只是想象吧。

Ceobe=刻俄柏
Ceobe and Rhodes Island first made contact as enemies on the battlefield. At the time, a hungry Ceobe attacked one of Rhodes Island's reserve squads while they were performing missions in Leithanien. The tired and hungry Ceobe was eventually defeated after a bitter battle. The Rhodes Island Operators then disarmed her and dropped her off at the Leithanian branch of Rhodes Island, but due to the deteriorating living conditions of the Infected in Leithanien, the team finally brought Ceobe back to the vessel. Along the way, Ceobe, who had always kept her distance from civilization, was slightly wary of communicating with others. However, after coming to Rhodes Island, she began to gain a new understanding of the people who had bested her - eat well, drink well, sleep well, and beat up bad people. Coincidentally, these are all things that she likes to do, so upon an Operator's recommendation, she joined Rhodes Island without hesitation.=刻俄柏与罗德岛的相遇是从一场对战开始的。当时，饥饿的刻俄柏袭击了一支在莱塔尼亚地区执行任务的罗德岛预备干员小队，在经过一番苦战后，又累又饿的刻俄柏理所当然被击败了。罗德岛的干员在解除她武装后，刻俄柏被送去了罗德岛莱塔尼亚分部等候发落。由于莱塔尼亚的感染者生存环境恶化，这支小队最终把刻俄柏带回了本舰。一路上，远离社会的刻俄柏稍稍被灌输了一些关于人际交往的注意事项，在来到罗德岛后，她又对击败自己的人有了新的认知——吃好、喝好、睡好以及打坏人。很巧，这些都是她喜欢做的事，所以在一位干员牵线搭桥后，她毫不犹豫选择了加入罗德岛。
Ceobe is always ready to go after the bad guys.=刻俄柏，随时准备打坏人。
Ceobe made many good friends after arriving at Rhodes Island, but the greatest, mightiest, and most reliable person of all in her eyes is the Doctor. Though the Doctor looks a lot weaker than her, she finds the Doctor to be much smarter than even Vulcan, capable of explaining concepts that seem utterly inconceivable to her in just a few simple words so that she can understand the gist of things. When being briefed on missions, she couldn't wrap her head around things like tactical simulations, but the Doctor had a brilliant idea - by giving her simple, concrete commands such as 'stand here,' 'attack this,' or 'fight until I arrive,' she was able to complete her missions. As a result, Ceobe was able to save some brain cells, and the Doctor entered the ranks of the few people who Ceobe would completely set her weapons down around.\nOther than the Doctor, the person who Ceobe respects the most is Vulcan.=刻俄柏来罗德岛以后交了不少好朋友，其中最大，最强，最让刻俄柏佩服的就是博士了。虽然博士看上去比她弱了不少，但博士聪明，比火神大姐还聪明，很多想不通的事情，博士随便讲两句，她就能明白个大概。出任务的时候，她听不太懂战术预演之类的东西，但博士就很厉害，和她说着“站这里”，“打这个”，“打到博士来”之类的指令，任务就完成了。这让刻俄柏省了不少脑细胞，也让博士成为了少数几个能让刻俄柏完全放下戒备的人。\n除了博士以外，刻俄柏最依赖的就是火神了。这或许是源自于一个武器使用者对铁匠的信赖，也有可能是火神米诺斯的身份让刻俄柏向往，或许是两者兼有让火神变得不可替代。总之，刻俄柏不在自己房间或是博士办公室的时候，有很大几率会待在火神的工坊里，即使什么都不做，只是窝在那儿看着火神工作，她好像也会变得很快乐。根据一些干员间的传闻，平时闷声不响的火神在休息时，如果刻俄柏在身边，她会给她吃些零食，然后聊上几句继续干活。这实在是——\n太奇妙了。

Courier is an employee of the Karlan Trade Co. LTD, and was born in Kjerag. He is part of the cooperation agreement between the Karlan Trade Co. and Rhodes Island, by which he helps carry out missions for the latter.=讯使，谢拉格出身，喀兰贸易公司成员。作为喀兰贸易公司与罗德岛合作协定的一部分，以外派人员身份参与罗德岛任务。
Courier prefers to operate in the rear, but that does not mean he is reluctant to fight, only that everything is already in place, and fighting is merely the last resort.\nBe relieved when he stands by your side, because that means you need not worry about most of your worries anymore.\n<@lv.item><Icy Surface></> Applies 'Cold' to units on top of it, and increases the distance Frozen enemies on it are shifted.\n<@lv.item><Penetrating Cold></> During Snowfall, all enemies are pushed in a certain direction.\n<@lv.item><Snowsant's Safe Escape Crane></> Immediately withdraws an Operator, and greatly reduces Redeployment Time.=相较而言，讯使更喜欢后方的工作，但这并不意味着他排斥战斗——一切都已安排得当，战斗不过是最后的保底手段罢了。\n当他站在你身边的时候，你应该感到放松，因为这意味着，很多你原本担心的事情已经不用担心了。\n<@lv.item><冰面></>对其上的单位施加“寒冷”，增加被冻结敌人在其上的位移距离\n<@lv.item><刺骨寒风></>降雪时，向特定方向推动所有敌人\n<@lv.item><雪雉的安全起重机></>立即撤退一名干员，并减少大量再部署时间

Courier rarely loses his signature faint smile, though it should be noted that he has another side - a calm, tranquil, and peaceful side characteristic of one from the snowlands. Only his enemies and his most trusted friends get the chance to see that side of him. If he loses his smile while talking to you, that can only mean one thing - he regards you as a dear friend.=讯使很少会去掉他那标志性的，淡淡的微笑，但值得注意的是，他也有着另外的一面，那是属于雪境的，冷静，平和的一面。只有他的敌人，和他最信赖的人有机会目睹那样的面容。如果他会撤去笑容同你交谈，那只说明一件事——你已是他无可替代的挚友。

Courier's keen sense of the terrain and environment is entirely from years of experience. In fact, when he was a child, he was not only unfamiliar with the roads, but he would even get lost. The way he tells it, he once got snowbound when he went out to play and almost didn't make it home alive. Fortunately, SilverAsh was hunting nearby and found him, thus returning him to safety. Because of this, no matter who might try to convince or threaten him to turn his back on SilverAsh, Courier will forever be the man's most faithful supporter.=讯使对地形和环境的敏锐直觉完全来自于长年累月的经验积累，事实上，小时候的他不仅不怎么识路，甚至还会迷路。据他所说，在一次外出游玩时曾经被风雪困住，差点就没法活着回家了。幸好在那附近狩猎野味的银灰发现了他，才让讯使能够安然活到现在。因此，无论其他势力如何威逼利诱，讯使永远是银灰最忠实的拥护者。

But time heals all wounds, and the two are no longer the warriors crossing swords that they once were. Earthspirit became infected while collecting Originium samples in the field. She seems rather apathetic towards her infection, however, because it failed to enhance her connection to Originium or any other geological formation. In fact, it has turned out to be a major hindrance to her work. She completely trusts the course of treatment offered to her because she hasn't the time to worry about her affliction.\nTo raise funds for her research, Earthspirit would also provide early Catastrophe warnings to towns and cities nearby while performing field surveys. Therefore making her a Catastrophe Messenger (despite her repeated insistence that it's only a second job, people still sought out her expertise).\nAmong the Herlads of Catastrophe, Earthspirit and Provence are friends (Provence still performs her duties as a Catastrophe Messenger while serving as a Rhodes Island Operator). Earthspirit also mentors volcanologist and fellow Caprinae, Eyjafjalla, on occasion.=地灵成为感染者的契机是在一次针对源石采样的田野调查中。不过对于自己成为感染者一事，她显得缺乏兴趣，因为这并未使她更加贴近源石或别的什么石头，反而成了妨碍她工作的关键。地灵向提供给她治疗方案的罗德岛投入了百分百的信任，因为她根本没有功夫去管顾自己的病症。\n基于缺乏更多研究经费的原因，地灵在田野调查工作中会顺带帮助临近的村镇或城市提供有关天灾调查与预警的工作，这使得她成为了一名天灾信使（地灵着重地强调，天灾信使理应只是她的副业，但人们显然是因为这层身份才更多地求助于她，这使得她非常困扰）。\n在天灾信使中，地灵与普罗旺斯有一定交情（在罗德岛，作为干员的普罗旺斯依然发挥着天灾信使这一重要的职能），而对于同族后辈，同时也是火山学家的艾雅法拉，地灵在工作中也对其多有照顾。

Ela is skeptical of authority, and not afraid to butt heads with superiors over orders that seem unreasonable.\nThat does not mean she objects to everything indiscriminately, only that her ability, independent nature and strong will make her unwilling to accept an overbearing attitude from those who are less informed, something that is perhaps colored by her previous experiences. On the other hand, pairing Ela with good teammates and giving astute commands goes a long way toward avoiding conflict with her.\nAs a matter of fact, Ela has maintained a good relationship with Rhodes Island following an initial acclimation period, partly because Rhodes Island does not interfere with Team Rainbow's operations, and partly because Rhodes Island has demonstrated trustworthy competence, while also trusting Ela's decisions in the field.=艾拉对权威保持着一贯的质疑态度。如果命令的内容在她看来缺乏合理性，她不惜和发号施令者吵上一架。\n不过，她也不是那种无条件地反对一切命令的刺头，她只是有着过硬的能力，独立的性格，坚决的态度——也许还有一些让她印象深刻的经历——让她无法对外行或是老顽固的指手画脚忍气吞声。出色的队友和明智的指令总能使艾拉免于产生烦躁和对抗的情绪。\n事实上，在经历了短暂的磨合期后，艾拉和罗德岛的合作关系一直维持得很好。这一方面是因为罗德岛不会干预彩虹小队的行动；另一方面，罗德岛展现出了足以让艾拉信任的能力，也愿意去信任艾拉的临场判断，这种相互的信任关系无论对哪一方来说都弥足珍贵。
Ela is the most independent and mercurial member of Team Rainbow that we have encountered.\nShe can pick up a spraypaint can and hang out with operators who hail from the streets, talk at length about advanced art theory, or hand a blanket to a patient sitting outside the Medical Department and strike up a conversation.\nWhen the application of force is called for, she can deploy her Grzmot mine with great precision, or lead an elite squad to achieve its objectives.\nThe combination of art and military in her background may remind some of Leithanien casters, but she shares few other traits with them. It is hard to define her, and that's how she likes it.=在我们结识的彩虹小队成员中，艾拉是最特立独行的一位。\n她能抄起喷漆罐和出身街头的干员们打成一片，也能就艺术理论侃侃而谈，还能在医疗部外给目光茫然的病患递上毛毯，借机和对方聊上两句。\n而在需要使用武力的场合，她又能精准地把雷鸣地雷丢在指定位置上，或是领导一队各自身怀绝技的战斗人员达成战术目标。\n很明显，她具有艺术和军事两方面的背景。一般人在觉得有点矛盾后会一拍脑门想到莱塔尼亚的术师，但艾拉和那些家伙又完全没什么相似之处——对我们来说，她是个很难被定义的人，而她自己似乎并不讨厌这样的评价。
Ela prefers to listen to other people's stories over telling her own. Of her other family, Ela says little, except that her father is dead, and that she is not on good terms with her sister.\nAlthough Ela's attitude is cold when she talks of her sister, she displays a little bit of pride when discussing how she has embarked on this unknown journey, while her sister has not. Every inch of Iberian soil has a corresponding position on the flagship's deck. The components follow the mountain ranges, the cables represent the rivers. Several grammarians and rhetoricians were involved in the design, and they conferred meaning to everything on this deck. Polishing and waxing the deck that symbolizes their hometown and evaluating which section is smoother and shinier became a way for crew from different parts of the country to privately compete.\nThere have been attempts in the past to swap out more susceptible-to-damage parts in the loading area for pieces of the deck in the other areas. For centuries, the energy found in Originium has both worried and motivated us. In the history of its taming, the most exciting achievement ever made was undoubtedly the technology to generate electricity with it. This breakthrough single-handedly solved the problem of the high cost of Originium Arts conductors and accelerated the economization of Originium energy, while also improving its safety and ease of use.\nThanks to this technology, a wide range of products that require a stable supply of Originium energy have become available on the market. These include lighting equipment that has no risk of explosion and no need for high maintenance costs, something that we now take for granted. The unearthing of Originium energy had an explosive impact on Terra, and it was this technology that turned that impact into a trickling stream that continues to enrich each and every nomadic city.\n—From the preface of Nomadic City Technologies Discussions, Volume 3=源石之中所蕴含的，那股躁动不安的能量，在数个世纪以来都困扰着，也激励着我们。而在将其驯化的历史中，最令人兴奋与骄傲的杰作之一，无疑是利用源石提取并转化电能的技术。这种转换一举化解了源石技艺良导体成本高昂的问题，促进了源石能源的经济化；同时，也进一步拓展了源石能源的安全化和易用化。\n受益于这样的技术，多种需要源石稳定供能的产品都得以普及至民用市场，其中就包括我们现今早就不以为奇的、没有爆炸风险且无需高昂维护成本的照明设备。源石能源的发掘对泰拉是一场爆炸式的冲击，而此项技术，则将这场冲击化作了滋润移动城市血管每一缕末梢的涓涓细流。\n——《移动城市技术漫谈，第三辑》序言

Friston 3 is an S-C Model four-wheeled Operation Platform, the first product of the Rhodes Island Smart Operation platform R&D Team's efforts. Closure personally led the team throughout the development process, from concept design to assembly and testing. Friston-3 is also based on PRTS, achieving a new comprehensive standard for operation platforms, from the underlying source code to the external modules. He weighs less than the other retrofitted operation platforms on Rhodes Island, while being more versatile and stable, and currently participates in operations as a Defender Operator.\n[Classified Log]\nThe source code for Friston-3's core, compiled ideations, and other design details are temporarily unavailable to Operators, so please contact Closure directly if you have any questions.=S-C型四轮作业平台Friston-3，罗德岛智能作业平台研发团队正式成立后的首个成果。Friston-3由可露希尔亲自主持概念设计、落地组装与测试应用，依托于PRTS，实现了从底层代码到外部模块的全面革新。相比罗德岛上的其他改型作业平台，他更加轻便，却拥有更为全面也更为稳定的性能，现作为重装干员参与相关作战任务。\n【权限记录】\n有关Friston-3核心代码的来源、编写思路及更多的设计细节，暂不向各位干员开放查询权限，如有疑问可直接咨询可露希尔。

Glaucus's internal evaluation is very interesting. It is unknown if this is just her nature or if she's just used to going with the flow, but as a newcomer, Glaucus does not speak much. In a corner of Sami lies a clearing surrounded by snow-covered thorns, and you don't know when exactly you ended up inside. The light of the twin moons descend from the sky, and although it gives off no heat, it is as dazzling as the sun. Iris came looking for an Operator.\nAt first, we thought this Operator would be Iris's blood relative, or perhaps one removed, or the beneficiary of her will. After deeper discussion, though, Iris informed us that she'd come to return an Operator's safekept item—an old-fashioned radio. The only information she knew was this Operator's real name and external appearance; after all, Iris's true age may be younger than that of the radio before us. As for how she received this from the Operator twenty years ago, and why she's returning it twenty years later, we haven't the faintest clue, but seeing as Iris is here, we have an obligation to her and said Operator in resolving this property's ownership. As this will involve some formalities, processes, and raising of complex personal issues, until these matters are solved, Iris is required to stay aboard in the long-term, and after consulting her own views, we've registered her as an Operator for the time being.=爱丽丝是为了寻找一位干员而来。\n一开始，我们曾认为这位干员与爱丽丝有着血缘关系，或是她的远亲，或是她的遗嘱受益人。但在进行深入交谈后，爱丽丝告知我们，她是为了归还某位干员的寄存物——一个老式的收音机而来。而她唯一知道的信息，只是这位干员的真实姓名与外貌描述，毕竟，爱丽丝的实际年龄，可能还没有眼前这个收音机要长。关于她是如何在二十年前从那位干员手中收到这个物件，为何要在二十年后将其归还，我们完全没有头绪，但爱丽丝既然来了，我们有义务为她，也为那位干员解决这件财产的归属问题，由于这其中涉及到一些手续和流程，还有更加复杂的私人问题，在处理好所有相关事项前，爱丽丝需要长期留岛，而在征询过本人意见后，我们将其注册为了临时干员。

Lena the Perfumer is from a renowned, well-off Minosian family, unfamiliar with the ways of the world. Her race prides themselves on their keen sense of smell, but hers is outstanding even among the Vulpo, giving Lena a special edge in the world of perfume making. She joined Rhodes Island through regular application channels, overseeing the 'Convalescent Garden' and providing assistance to operators as needed.=调香师莱娜，米诺斯大家族出身，家境殷实，不谙世事。虽然种族特性以听觉灵敏著称，但调香师的嗅觉更在其上，因此在香料调制上有着极高天赋。她通过正常应聘程序来到罗德岛，作为休养设施“疗养庭院”的管理人为其他干员提供支援。
Lena was raised in a prosperous family without having to work for a living, allowing her to pursue her passions with little to no risk. She loved nature, plants, and especially the smell of flowers and sunshine. Choosing to become a perfumer was her way of expressing that passion.\nLena worked hard and dedicated herself to her perfumes, eventually deciding to develop her own business without help from her family. In the early stages, she struggled due to her inexperience. Nothing was going right. But with pride and confidence befitting the member of a prestigious clan, she turned setbacks into motivation and pushed past the lows.\nWhenever she lifted up one of her plants with mud-covered hands, she would feel invigorated by the scent of a brand new aroma.=莱娜成长于一个兴旺发达的家族，不必为生计发愁，这样的家庭环境使得她可以尽情投入自己的兴趣而不必承担太多的风险。莱娜热爱自然，喜欢植物、花香和阳光，选择调香师作为职业正是对这份热爱的回应。\n作为调香师的莱娜以专注而努力的态度对待自己的工作，并且她已经决定在不借助家庭帮助的情况下，将这份工作发展为自己的一项事业。在最初的阶段，较少亲自体验劳动与工作的莱娜吃了许多苦头，调香的学习和实践均遭遇了一段时间的低谷。但出身大家的莱娜凭借长久养成的骄傲和自信，将本应沉浸于沮丧于沮丧中的情绪化为了自身前进的行动力，以惊人的毅力熬过了最艰难的时期。\n当莱娜用沾满泥土的双手，捧起由自己亲手栽培的花束时，她嗅到了一阵从未体验过的芳香。
Lena's Rest=莱娜的憩所
Lena's uncanny sense of smell made her who she is today. She can sniff out a particular good at the marketplace, or track down any individual at Rhodes Island with her nose alone. She could probably earn a decent living off those abilities, but her perfectionist bent ultimately led her to the craft of medicinal perfumes. It's a challenge for Lena, but one she accepted and dominated through her diligence and commitment to the idea that combining perfume with modern medicine would open up new possibilities (especially in the field of psychology).=对气味的敏感成就了莱娜现在的能力。她能在气味繁杂的市场中分辨她想要的东西是否混杂其中，也可以在整个罗德岛中通过嗅觉找到特定的人物。她本能比现在做的更多，但是，天性中对于美好的追求，让她最终接受了以医学作为主导的崭新调香形式。对于莱娜本人来说，这是一项挑战，而生性谨慎的莱娜用事实证明了，将香薰与现代医疗相结合的行为（尤其反应在心理调控方面），的确可以带来崭新的可能性。

Liu'er appears to know something is behind her. She begins talking aloud, speaking of secrets that happened during the development of the Waking Tower, disturbances in time, and how she has been having more and more fleeting dreams of glory these days. In the end, she asks you what the person behind her looks like. You look at the graceful, floral shadow behind her. It lifts a finger to its lips, urging you to stay silent. After giving Liu'er's hair a gentle stroke, it vanishes into thin air.=柳儿似乎知道自己背后有些什么，她开始自言自语，说着开发醒时塔的秘辛、时间的扰动，以及最近越来越频繁的黄粱之梦。最终，她询问你自己背后的人是什么样貌。你看着她背后的花影，那道飘逸的影子竖起手指放在唇边，示意你不要透露，而后便摸了摸柳儿的头，消散在空中。
Liu'er excitedly invites you to 'try' the Chamber of Geists' newest invention. You decline, citing your tight purse strings, but then you spot her casually scribbling on a ledger. Now, your excuse no longer stands.=柳儿热情邀请你“试用”伥物房的新发明，你以囊中羞涩为由婉拒，却看到她爽快地在账簿上划拉了几笔。现在，你的理由不成立了。
Liu'er invented this as she could not enter Sui's Remnant Consciousness herself.=柳儿进不了岁兽残识，于是便有了这项发明。
Liu'er is a minor official at the Sui Regulator's Chamber of Geists, whose main duty is to analyze and conduct R&D on all sorts of geists and ceremonial devices for your party. She has pacified many waregeists, using them to further her exploration and renovation of the Garden to great effect. But as for actually using her inventions, which have received mixed reviews... You have your reservations. They always cost a pretty penny... Oh, she's here... What's that chunk of wood she's holding?=柳儿是司岁台伥物房的吏员，主职乃是为你们一行人解析、开发各类伥物与仪具。她镇抚过许多器伥，随后将之投入对界园的探索与修缮，卓有成效。但对于是否要使用她那些毁誉参半的发明......你持保留意见，毕竟，总是免不了要支付一笔不小的......哦，她来了......手上捧着个木疙瘩？
Liu'er stands by your side, her new invention at the ready to take care of any hindrances the Hour of Sui throws your way. However... Yes, as always, you must give her something first...=柳儿就在你身旁，随时准备用她的新发明解决岁时带来的阻碍。然而......是的，就和往常一样，你总得给她点什么......
Liu'er suddenly turns her head, but sees nothing behind her. As she does so, the shadow of risk appears behind you, giving you a light pat on the shoulder that says you should treasure your friendship with her. Before Liu'er can turn her head back, the shadow has left the workshop. Logos, elite caster operator, Arts master, and young 'Hostess' of the Convallis of the Banshees. Participated in the Kazdel Civil War as one of Babel's core members, and became one of the first elite operators of Rhodes Island. He is credited with establishing the standards and procedures for assessing an operator's Originium Arts assimilation, the definitive benchmark for predicting future Arts potential.\nHis current duties include field command, assessment and selection of caster operators, and encrypting and deciphering sensitive intel.=逻各斯，罗德岛精英术师干员，咒术大师，女妖河谷年轻的“女主人”。曾作为巴别塔核心成员参与卡兹戴尔内战，并于罗德岛建立之初成为首批精英干员之一。逻各斯着手制定了干员源石技艺适应性测试的标准及流程。这套评估系统展现了巨大的价值，令罗德岛得以准确地评估每一位干员的施术潜能。\n现根据罗德岛决议，逻各斯继续担任外勤小队指挥，参与术师干员的测试与选拔，负责敏感情报的破译及加密工作。

Lyudmila and I? No, you got it wrong. Calling ourselves 'Reunion' wasn't her idea. Back then, most people in the city didn't really know what Reunion stood for or what they did, but a name that brings change is enough to make it happen when you're talking life or death.=我和柳德米拉？不，你误会了，在泽尔格勒自称“整合运动”不是她的主意。当时城里大部分人并不清楚他们的主张和事迹，但在生死的困境里，一个常与改变挂钩的名字，足以成为改变的开端。
Lyudmila Ilyinichna, a former Reunion squad leader who dealt in covert operations and assassinations, specializing in melee combat and breaking through defensive lines. She parted with Reunion in the wake of the Chernobog-Lungmen Incident, and approached Rhodes Island at the end of 1100. She is currently receiving Oripathy treatment while under supervision.=柳德米拉·伊里尼奇娜，原整合运动干部，从事潜伏活动与突袭暗杀行动，擅长近身攻击及突破防御阵线进行奇袭，于切尔诺伯格-龙门事件之后脱离整合运动，1100年末主动与罗德岛接洽，现正在监督下接受矿石病治疗。
Lyudmila is never shy about announcing her presence.\nThe spread of her smoke loudly announces that the assassin has taken the field. It strikes fear into her enemy's hearts, for they know that death inevitably accompanies it.\nThey search and swing their weapons in vain, watching helplessly as she walks out of the smoke...\nLike the wind over the snow.\n<@lv.item><Active Originium></> Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and ASPD will be increased significantly.=柳德米拉从不吝于展示自己的存在。\n当烟雾在战场上蔓延时，所有人都知道，她来了，一个刺客正面踏上了战场。但是，所有人对此却只能感到惶恐，因为这阵烟雾只代表一个意思——“有人会死在这里”。\n他们只能徒劳地寻找，徒劳地挥舞兵器，最后，徒劳地看着她走出烟雾。\n就像一阵吹过冰原的风。\n<@lv.item><活性源石></>部署于其上的我军和经过的敌军持续受到伤害，但攻击力和攻速大幅度提升

Unlike most Medic Operators, she did not have a full grasp of the principles and practice of modern medicine, nor did she score well on written exams, but she knew the human body and functions like the back of her hand. Starting next year, the Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz will raise the corporate contribution ratio across the board in some territories. Operator Myrrh's herbal mix was deemed a great medicine, but it has all the drawbacks of a premodern pharmaceutical: Uniquely indigenous ingredients, complicated creation processes, extremely bitter taste, and even elements of witchcraft as part of the recipe. The modern medical community saw it as a relic doomed to obsolescence.\nBut at Myrrh's insistence, Dr. Kal'tsit developed a special training course with modern technology specifically for her. The training has produced positive results.\nMyrrh quickly mastered a simplified pharmaceutical process and applied it to her work. Operators familiar with Adnachiel tend to use one word to describe the angel: bright. No matter how complicated the subject or advanced the technology involved, he seems to have no trouble mastering it in a short period of time.\nIn a show of humility, Adnachiel stands helpless in the face of loftier, theoretical topics, though everyone assumes he's just being modest. After all, as soft spoken and kind as he is, Adnachiel gives off the impression of being a clever and considerate young man. After meeting him, most operators come to understand his observant and sensitive personality. He always speaks to the true nature of things, but the scope of his theories is limited to that over which he has immediate control. Through his analyses, he can even predict the short-term future of his targets. He consistently rejects the titles of both 'prophet' and 'genius pretty boy,' but rumors about him continue to proliferate.=熟悉安德切尔的干员同僚们都习惯用一个词汇形容这位天使：聪慧。即使是相当复杂的学识和技术，安德切尔都能在很短的时间内将之洞悉、掌握。\n虽然安德切尔曾谦虚地表示，一旦涉及更加高深的理论，他就会束手无策，但大家也都仅仅把这当作是安德切尔的谦逊。毕竟，安德切尔在社交场合下表现出的那种沉默和自然，都让人心生好感，更会认定这是个智慧而有涵养的年轻人。一旦与他交流，干员们就更能感受到他惊人的观察力和令人赞叹的敏感。他的言语一刻也没有偏离过事物的本质，而他理论范畴内的所有事物似乎都无法脱离他的掌控，凭借分析，他甚至能推导出目标短暂的未来。尽管他拒绝被称作是“先知”或者“知道很多的小白脸”，但和他有关的传言实在是数不胜数。

Passive Effect: Stone trigger range and damage range expand, dealing 320% ATK as Arts damage\nActive Effect: Stops attacking but Attack Range expands; grants 8 stones, then any stones above the limit are placed within Attack Range, prioritizing tiles with enemies; when manually placing stones within Attack Range, stones can be placed on tiles with enemies and Talent 1 deploys up to 3 additional stones at the cost of an equal amount of ammo\nSkill activation grants 20 ammo, skill ends when manually deactivated or stones are depleted, any ammo remaining is refunded as stones=被动效果：棋子的触发和伤害范围扩大，造成相当于攻击力320%的法术伤害\n主动效果：停止攻击但攻击范围扩大；立即获得8枚棋子，然后将超出上限的棋子优先部署在范围内敌人所在位置；在攻击范围内手动部署棋子时可部署至敌人所在位置，且第一天赋额外至多部署3枚棋子并消耗等量弹药\n装有20发弹药，手动停止或棋子耗尽后技能结束，剩余的弹药返还为棋子
Passive Effect: Stone trigger range and damage range expand, dealing 340% ATK as Arts damage\nActive Effect: Stops attacking but Attack Range expands; grants 8 stones, then any stones above the limit are placed within Attack Range, prioritizing tiles with enemies; when manually placing stones within Attack Range, stones can be placed on tiles with enemies and Talent 1 deploys up to 3 additional stones at the cost of an equal amount of ammo\nSkill activation grants 20 ammo, skill ends when manually deactivated or stones are depleted, any ammo remaining is refunded as stones=被动效果：棋子的触发和伤害范围扩大，造成相当于攻击力340%的法术伤害\n主动效果：停止攻击但攻击范围扩大；立即获得8枚棋子，然后将超出上限的棋子优先部署在范围内敌人所在位置；在攻击范围内手动部署棋子时可部署至敌人所在位置，且第一天赋额外至多部署3枚棋子并消耗等量弹药\n装有20发弹药，手动停止或棋子耗尽后技能结束，剩余的弹药返还为棋子
Passive Effect: Stone trigger range and damage range expand, dealing 360% ATK as Arts damage\nActive Effect: Stops attacking but Attack Range expands; grants 8 stones, then any stones above the limit are placed within Attack Range, prioritizing tiles with enemies; when manually placing stones within Attack Range, stones can be placed on tiles with enemies and Talent 1 deploys up to 3 additional stones at the cost of an equal amount of ammo\nSkill activation grants 20 ammo, skill ends when manually deactivated or stones are depleted, any ammo remaining is refunded as stones=被动效果：棋子的触发和伤害范围扩大，造成相当于攻击力360%的法术伤害\n主动效果：停止攻击但攻击范围扩大；立即获得8枚棋子，然后将超出上限的棋子优先部署在范围内敌人所在位置；在攻击范围内手动部署棋子时可部署至敌人所在位置，且第一天赋额外至多部署3枚棋子并消耗等量弹药\n装有20发弹药，手动停止或棋子耗尽后技能结束，剩余的弹药返还为棋子
Passive Effect: Stone trigger range and damage range expand, dealing 380% ATK as Arts damage\nActive Effect: Stops attacking but Attack Range expands; grants 8 stones, then any stones above the limit are placed within Attack Range, prioritizing tiles with enemies; when manually placing stones within Attack Range, stones can be placed on tiles with enemies and Talent 1 deploys up to 3 additional stones at the cost of an equal amount of ammo\nSkill activation grants 20 ammo, skill ends when manually deactivated or stones are depleted, any ammo remaining is refunded as stones=被动效果：棋子的触发和伤害范围扩大，造成相当于攻击力380%的法术伤害\n主动效果：停止攻击但攻击范围扩大；立即获得8枚棋子，然后将超出上限的棋子优先部署在范围内敌人所在位置；在攻击范围内手动部署棋子时可部署至敌人所在位置，且第一天赋额外至多部署3枚棋子并消耗等量弹药\n装有20发弹药，手动停止或棋子耗尽后技能结束，剩余的弹药返还为棋子

Performs an attack with 140% ATK against all enemies in range, inflicting -60 ASPD and -60% Movement Speed on targets for 5s. This skill can only be used once per battle.=立刻对攻击范围内所有敌人造成进行一次攻击力为140%的攻击并使目标在5秒内攻击速度-60，移动速度-60%，该次攻击每击中一个敌人获得攻击力+15%（最多叠加5次），接下来的伤害类型变为真实且可以同时攻击2名敌人；整场战斗中该技能只能释放一次

Pinecone is a former construction worker from Columbia. After she became involved in the Mansfield incident, she came to Rhodes Island to seek work alongside Mountain. Owing to her previous work experience, she is currently assigned to the Engineering Department as an assistant to some of our operators there.=哥伦比亚建筑工人松果，被卷入曼斯菲尔德事件后，随山来到罗德岛求职，因其先前的工作经验，现于工程部担任部分干员的助手。
Pinecone is about to leave that small town once more. Knowing his daughter no longer has to worry about the future, the laborer suddenly stuffs a doll into her hands. She stares at it in a daze, but luckily the little guy waves a hand in her stead.=松果即将再次离开那个小镇。知道女儿已经不必为将来发愁的工人突然塞过来一个玩偶，她怔愣着接过，幸好这小家伙代替她挥了挥手。
Pinecone was born in an average Columbian laborer family. Like much of Columbia's laborers, her parents jumped on the Columbian exploration bandwagon. The wave they rode lasted far longer than anyone could have imagined, and the Columbians' desire to expand and the subsequent conquest continued day and night without cease. The laborers, made of flesh and blood, were simply not meant to keep up with these massive industrial machines—And so her parents chose to settle in a remote but quiet Columbian town, a place that was getting farther and farther away from the roars of the pioneers' machines by the day. This was where Pinecone was born one spring, and it was where she lived a brief but nonetheless happy childhood.=松果出生在哥伦比亚一个普通的工人家庭。她的父母如同大部分哥伦比亚工人一样，投身于哥伦比亚浩瀚的拓荒浪潮。这股浪潮持续之久，超乎想象，拓张的欲望和征服并没有停歇，但血肉凡胎的工人们却不能永远追随巨大工业机械的脚步——在某个春天，松果出生在一处偏僻却安宁的哥伦比亚城镇。在这座逐渐听不见拓荒队伍机械轰鸣的镇子里，松果度过了短暂却幸福的童年。

Podenco is an operator who applied to join Rhodes Island through a normal process, and is responsible for taking care of the greenhouse and cultivating flowers in Perfumer's Convalescent Garden. Can also be deployed as a combat operator and is capable of utilizing her understanding of plants to heal teammates or disrupt enemies.=波登可是以普通流程应聘进入罗德岛的干员，在调香师主管的庭院里负责照看温室与花卉培植。可以作为作战干员调动，运用对植物的理解医疗队友或扰乱敌人。
Podenco was born into a small settlement on the steppes near the border of Bolívar. While this remote settlement was able to escape the flames of war due to its distance from the center of Bolívar, this isolation also created its own problems. To ensure their survival, the people of this settlement delved into their natural talents at evading Catastrophes and cultivating crops. Podenco has been interested in a variety of plants since a young age, likes to make dried flowers, and also tended a small nursery back home. As she grew up, she became involved in the community's farming efforts, gaining rich experience in botanical cultivation for plants both edible and ornamental. When asked which type of plants she prefers, Podenco will quietly tell you that she likes flowers more, but when food and clothing become a scarcity, she will silently stash away her personal preferences deep into her heart.=波登可出生在玻利瓦尔边境高原的小聚落中。这支聚落由于远离玻利瓦尔中心而得以躲避战乱，但由此也引发了新的问题。为了保证生存，这支聚落发掘了族人在躲避天灾和培育作物上的才能。波登可从小就对各种植物感兴趣，喜欢制作干花，也懂得呵护家中的小苗圃，当稍长大一点后，就开始参与进聚落的作物培植工作中，在此期间，波登可积累了非常丰富的植物培植经验，这些植物中有可食的，也有可观赏的。硬要说波登可喜欢哪种多一点，她会悄悄告诉你她更喜欢花卉，但在当时温饱都成问题的情况下，她还是默默将这份喜好压在了心底。

Saga=嵯峨
Saga often fought Ink Spirits in the scrolls. After some time, she realized their personalities reflect how they are treated. Learn from them, and they are friendly; oppose them, and they are hostile. That which are alike are attracted to each other; that which are different are repelled by each other. Saga thought she had seen through the simple logic of the Ink Spirits, until the day she broke through the painting, and something occurred to her: A soul in a mortal realm, versus ink on paper; what attracts them to each other, or repels them from each other?=在画卷中时，嵯峨常和墨魉们交手。最初不明就里，时间久了，嵯峨也看出墨魉的性情黑白分明：你若学它，它便同你亲近；你若逆它，它便同你冲撞。同类相感，异类相忌，嵯峨以为自己看破了墨魉们的简单道理。直到冲破画障的那一天，她忽然想起，一为尘中身，一为纸上墨，她与它们究竟凭何相感，为何相忌？
Saga's Badge=嵯峨证章
Saga's bewilderment is starkly plain, so much that it makes people wonder how this world of ours could still hold people so untarnished. With all the doubts surrounding her, we soon had answers.\nThe mature may say: you should learn to reconcile, understand you can't settle it all yourself, then strive to do all you can.\nThe sly may say: you should follow the flow, that resistance makes pains, and it's more worth it just to dive in.\nThe wrathful may say: you should go forth with head held high, eternally unsurrendering, and fight to your life's last end.\nThe timid may say: you should seclude back in the mountains and forests, return to your own monastery, and forget all such tumult.\nThe right answer? There is no right answer. What there are are only choices.\nWe look forward to the choices Saga makes.=嵯峨的迷茫非常质朴，甚至到了能让人感慨这片大地上竟然还有这么纯洁的人的程度，因为对于她的疑问，我们早有答案。\n成熟的人会说，你应当学会和解，理解自己无法解决一切，然后做力所能及的事。\n圆滑的人会说，你应当顺应潮流，反抗多么苦痛，不如加入其中。\n愤怒的人会说，你应当勇往直前，永远不要放弃，战斗到生命的最后一刻。\n胆小的人会说，你应当归隐山林，回到自己的寺庙，忘记那些纷扰。\n正确答案？没有正确答案，有的只有选择。\n我们期待着嵯峨做出选择。

Sakiko came to Rhodes Island from the Castle of Dreams, and is almost never seen without the other members of Ave Mujica. The five of them, each thinking in different ways and pursuing different things, have been able to come together as a single band and work towards the same goal because of Sakiko.\nSakiko makes mistakes too, of course, but her strength is the ability to make decisions without fear. There would be no Ave Mujica without Sakiko's gentle strength.=从梦城堡来到罗德岛的祥子，总是跟Mujica的大家一同活动。她们虽是一个整体，但是每个人都有着自己的想法，追求着不同的东西。明明性格迥异，但却能紧密合作，而这都是因为祥子。\n祥子当然也会失误，但是她总能勇于做出决定。祥子柔和而又坚定，正是有如此的她，才有如此的Ave Mujica。
Sakiko has asked us not to put too much pressure on Mutsumi. Mutsumi's mother is a famous actress and her father a famous comedian, leading the entertainment industry and the public to place great expectations on her, something that has troubled her all her life. Outside of her remarkable family circumstances, however, she is simply a kind-hearted girl who struggles with communication.\nSakiko tells us that she knows she cannot shelter Mutsumi all the time, but at least she wants to give Mutsumi a place where she can feel safe and comfortable.=祥子嘱托我们，希望罗德岛的大家不要给睦太大的压力。睦作为著名女演员和搞笑艺人的女儿，从小被整个演艺圈和大众寄予厚望，而这厚望恰恰是她最大的苦恼。明明抛开显赫的家世，睦本质上只是个不善表达、心地善良的少女。\n祥子告诉我们，她知道自己并不能完全保护好睦，但是，她仍想要给睦建立一个能安心些许的地方。
Sakiko is an active participant in a variety of work aboard the landship. Normally dignified and elegant, she shows no qualms about taking up simple communications assignments or manual labor tasks such as cleaning and transporting items; she carries out all her jobs without complaint. It is as though she already had a fair amount of experience with such work before coming to Rhodes Island. During work, she is always sunny and positive, while also showing care and concern for those around her. Her kind smile has left a deep impression on many operators.=祥子在舰上工作得十分积极。举手投足都十足优雅的她，却出乎意料地一直参与着各种基础工作。无论是简单的信息传达，还是保洁、搬运等体力劳动，她从来没有抱怨过苦和累，仿佛在来到罗德岛前她就已经习惯了这样繁重的工作。在她完成这些工作的时候，还总能带着乐观开朗的态度面对身边的人。祥子总会关心身边的干员的状况，为他人担忧，她关切的笑容给很多干员留下了深刻的印象。

Savage=暴行
Savage earned her codename thanks to the massive destruction she causes both in combat and on mining missions. The codename also matches her physique.\nHowever, despite her name, Savage is a fairly kind and cheerful Operator. She is known to be friendly, reliable, and fun both on and off the battlefield.\nNote though, she is quite fierce when on the football field, so try not to yell at her while she's playing.=干员暴行的代号，据称来源于她经常在作战与矿物开采任务中造成的破坏，而干员的体格也同样足以支撑起这个代号。\n事实上，与代号相反，暴行是一个相当和善且开朗的干员。无论是在任务还是在生活中，暴行都被评价为友善、可靠且令人喜爱。\n当然，橄榄球场上的暴行很可怕。请不要在球场上对她口出狂言。
Savage made it clear she considers Amiya and Kal'tsit old-fashioned.\nSavage also stated her identity shouldn't matter to Rhodes Island. She believes as long as she is helping her friends, what and where her mission takes her is unimportant.\nShe will probably continue to fight as the only one who truly knows her limits.=干员暴行明确表示，自己与阿米娅/凯尔希医生，甚至是博士都是旧识。\n但干员暴行同样也声明，自己的身份对于罗德岛并不重要。她认为，只要能为自己的朋友贡献一份力量，那么无论身在何方、肩负的是何种任务，对她来说，都不重要。\n她大概就是会一直战斗下去。而真正的极限在哪里，只有她自己才了解。
Savage plays a very important role in combat. She clears obstacles to facilitate direct attacks against the enemy. She is also quite effective at protecting her teammates, and casualties are almost always lower than expected with her on a mission.\nSometimes she likes to get in the kitchen and make vegetable soups, mushroom pies, and other Rim Billitonian cuisine for her fellow Operators.\nMany Operators call her dishes comfort food.\nShe has been known to pitch in and help her teammates when she can, and she is increasingly well-liked.\nPlease do not post the names of suitors she has rejected on the bulletin board in the lounge. Thank you for your cooperation.=战斗中，干员暴行担任着相当重要的角色，无论是敲碎墙壁还是破除障碍，在干员暴行的帮助下，攻坚任务变得简单且高效。不仅如此，该干员还十分擅长运用种种手法保护其他干员，这使得暴行所在小队的伤亡率比行动预测估算的数值更低。\n生活中，干员暴行偶尔会在厨房中进行烹饪活动，为其他干员提供食物，包括蔬菜浓汤，蘑菇派等雷姆必拓菜肴。\n据部分干员描述，暴行所烹饪的菜肴使他们感受到一种如同家庭般的温暖。\n同时，干员暴行也常常帮助其他干员，这使得她在干员中的评价不断提升。\n请不要把被她拒绝的约会请求记录在各休息室公告栏上，谢谢合作。
Savage uses special Originium Arts in battle that detonate the ground struck by her hammer fractions of a second after impact. She has taken down difficult targets with these Arts.\nAfter a reverse-engineering study on her hammer, the engineering staff found her hammer was not armed with a blasting device at all, but rather, it acted as an unconventional staff. Savage uses the Originium housed inside the hammer to create the blasts.\nAlthough she doesn't fully understand the principles behind this power, when she is manipulating the hammer, she always unleashes tremendous explosive power.\nOther important information cannot be verified without further research.=干员暴行在战斗中使用了特殊的源石技艺，具体表现为，当干员暴行运用源石技艺之后，经受锤击的区域会在数毫秒至数十毫秒后发生爆破。干员暴行正是利用这种源石技艺破坏硬目标。\n在对干员暴行配备的战术爆破攻坚锤进行逆向工程研究之后，工程干员们发现，雷神工业所生产的此种爆破锤并未配备任何爆破装置，相反，它更像是一种变形魔杖。干员暴行能够运用爆破锤内部严格排布过的源石，产生类似微差爆破的效果。\n虽然该干员并未完全理解自己所施放的源石技艺的原理，但当她释放源石技艺时，往往会挟带大量放电现象。\n其它相关信息还需等待进一步研究的结果。

Shaw=阿消
Shaw has received many honors and medals in the past. One of these medals was personally awarded to her by Lungmen's chief executive.\nThese shiny medals are what encourages the fireman to always remain as determined as she was when she started out.=阿消曾获得过许多代表荣誉与认可的勋章，其中一枚由龙门最高长官亲手赠与。\n这些闪亮的奖牌激励消防员坚定自己最初的决心。
Shaw reports her first memory of fire came from the tragic loss of a beloved fruit vendor to arson. That was when she realized a person can create a Catastrophe from will alone, but will alone won't resolve it. The idea of becoming a firefighting expert took root in her mind, as she hoped to save all the good things in life from the threat of fire. It also strengthened her resolve as a Rhodes Island Operator. When faced with a malefactor out to cause a Catastrophe, she is always willing to stand against it. To Shaw, safeguarding the people from the suffering of an unexpected crisis is as precious and worth protecting as the feeling she gets from buying a big, round apple.=根据阿消的回忆，她对火灾的初次认知，来源于她曾经心爱的一家坚果专档因火灾而被彻底焚毁的事故。当她发现，灾难或许因人的意志而产生，但却从不会因人的意志而消失这个事实后，她开始产生了成为一名消防专家的想法。她希望能够避免那些因灾难而产生的，美好的事物彻底消失的故事。这种想法也塑造了阿消对于罗德岛干员的理解。当她发现一些抱有切实恶意或扭曲意志的人在引发灾难，给周遭的人造成不安全的后果时，她愿意去通过自己的行动消除这些灾难。对阿消来说，不再被灾难阴影笼罩下的人们的幸福，与自己收到又大又圆的榛果时的幸福，也许是相同珍贵的，值得保护的事物。

Skyfire actually is not arrogant or cynical. It's just that, to her, very few people can keep up with her leaps in logic and her visionary decisions. It's a failure in communication that is truly bothering her.\nSkyfire may not want to scold or criticize her peers, and her abrasiveness is perhaps an attempt to express her own greatness.\nFortunately, Skyfire does have some like-minded friends, with such a diversity of Operators on Rhodes Island. That offsets a bit of her discomfort and loneliness.\nAssuming she felt any.\nSome nosy Operators have claimed Skyfire apologized profusely to the Doctor for accidentally destroying mission debriefs.=其实干员天火并不是一个高傲且刻薄的人。只是对她来说，大多数人无法理解她高速运转的想法与富有远见的行动，进而在与她沟通时产生了障碍，而这才是让天火感到困扰的原因。\n天火也许并非想要训斥或者诘难他人，她只是找不到究竟该如何表达自己膨大且只能在大部分时间保持冷静的心情罢了。\n令人欣慰的是，她还有一群志同道合的朋友，罗德岛同样也有着多种多样的干员，这能够让她的不适与寂寞感稍微减少那么一丁点。\n如果她真有的话。\n而某些好事干员声称，她至少会为不小心烧掉博士的任务报告而红着脸道歉。
Skyfire is affiliated with King's Wand, the central organ of Foxtail, an Originium Arts research institute. A tech specialist from Victoria, she holds degrees in geology and Originium geology, and is respected in fields of Originium study both practical and theoretical.\nCurrently the Chief Caster stationed at Rhodes Island on loan from the King's Wand, Skyfire's mission is to jointly research Originium while providing combat mission assistance.=天火，隶属民间源石技艺研究会“狐尾”的核心团体“王者之杖”。拥有地质学与源石地质学双学位，维多利亚高等职业术师，在源石技艺及理论研究方面皆有杰出造诣。\n现任王者之杖驻罗德岛首席术师，与罗德岛签署合作协议，并为罗德岛的源石理论研究，歼灭战作战等多项任务提供协助。
Skyfire is an alumna from my university. She graduated soon after I entered since she skipped a year, but even still, she did look after me... Oh, speaking of! She's also the one who introduced me to Rhodes Island! It's thanks to her I'm receiving treatment here.=天火学姐是学校里的前辈，虽然我入学之后，学姐没多久就跳级毕业了，但是我也有被学姐关照过……对了，我来这里接受治疗，也是学姐帮忙介绍的呢。
Skyfire takes pride in her abilities. Nothing can escape the inferno she controls, and all boils down to her whim. Not to say she's a capricious person, however—after learning again and again how there's far too much that no flame can burn away, she's decided to stop pondering just what she ought to be doing. Since then, she's discovered something even more capable of scorching filth to cinders than flames—her intelligence.=天火自傲于自己的能力，没有什么能逃过由她操控的烈焰，一切只在她的想或者不想。但这并不代表她是一个恣意妄为的人，在一次又一次地发现总有太多火焰也无法焚烧殆尽的东西后，天火决定停下来思考，自己要做的究竟是什么。而后她发现了比火焰更能烧尽脏污的东西——她的智慧。

Sussurro did not think about the fact that she had become infected by volunteering to participate in the treatment of the infected. Even when three days had passed since she herself had been transformed from doctor to infected, she did not feel anything. Everything just seemed to happen so suddenly.\nIt wasn't until she witnessed a patient be declared untreatable and get sent to the intensive care unit with a blank stare that she made the connection between herself and the situation at hand.=因志愿参与救治感染者的行动而成为感染者这件事，苏苏洛没有仔细地想过。即使当她从医生成为病人经过了将近三天，她也尚未找到这件事带给自己的实感。一切都仿佛是突然发生的。\n直到她在监护病房窗外看到被宣告不治的患者，被送往关怀病房时呆滞的眼神时，她试图将这一场景和自己连接起来。
Sussurro is a graduate of the Siracusa-Palermo Medical Academy. She has a sufficient level of knowledge in basic medical care.\nShe is now a medic at Rhodes Island and is a respected member of the headquarters' logistics system.=苏苏洛，正式入职前为叙拉古帕勒莫市立医科学院毕业生。具备基础医疗方面的充足学识。\n现于罗德岛担任医疗干员，是总部后勤医疗体系内的坚实力量。
Sussurro is frequently misjudged by others for her appearance, but she really is a professional doctor.=苏苏洛经常因为外貌被人误解，但是她确实是一位专业医师。
Sussurro was born to an ordinary family in a large city in Siracusa. Her parents were ordinary citizens who worked in local public institutions. They had two sons and two daughters. Sussurro was their third child.\nAlthough Sussurro's parents wanted her to be a quiet, obedient child, she did not respond positively to these expectations. Sometimes this was to help her younger sister get back snacks her brothers had stolen, and sometimes this was to help her sister get a hold of a toy she couldn't have. Since her childhood, Sussurro has developed a personality that takes initiative.\nSussurro's two older brothers have already grown up and have gone into business. Her younger sister is studying in kindergarten. Sussurro herself chose to study medicine. She did not do so out of any grand ambition or dream, but because the medical industry in Siracusa holds promise and is a good field to work in.=干员苏苏洛出生于叙拉古某大型都市一个普通家庭中。其父母皆为普通市民，就职于当地的公职机构，并育有两子两女，苏苏洛是他们第三个孩子。\n尽管父母希望苏苏洛成为一个安静，听话的孩子，但苏苏洛似乎并未积极响应他们的期望。有时候是为了帮幺妹讨回被哥哥们偷吃的零食，有的时候又要为得不到玩具而大哭大闹的幺妹操心。自童年起，苏苏洛就形成了如今这样敢说敢做的性格。\n苏苏洛的两位兄长现已成人并进入公司工作，最小的妹妹尚在幼儿园就读。苏苏洛本人选择了就读医学专业，并不是为了远大的理想和美好愿望，只是因为医学行业在叙拉古当地的发展前景良好，是一份有前途的工作的缘故。

Utage=宴
Utage revels in the challenge of new things. As fashion is constantly shifting and lines up with her interests, she naturally pays more attention to these things. Over time, she has become a bit of an authority. What company is gearing up to release a new product, and how does its prospects on the market look? When Bibeak first came to Rhodes Island, her first request was whether there was a special place where she could tailor clothes and articles for work, but unfortunately, Rhodes Island has no shortage of those.\nFor her, sewing and weaving are ways of calming her mind. Influenced by her father's work as a designer, Bibeak's creations are both comfortable and visually striking. However, because she sometimes has difficulty deciding what to incorporate in a design, her overall style tends to be intricate and beautiful, qualities ill-suited for combat scenarios.\n\nBibeak seems to view designing clothing as a way of expressing her emotions. After getting to know her better, many operators have approached her with embarrassment, asking to have their measurements taken.=柏喙来到罗德岛的第一件事，就是询问是否有能够让她顺利剪裁缝制出衣物的专门场所，以及专业道具，而幸运的是，这些在罗德岛都可以找到。\n对于她来说，缝纫和纺织都是能够使心灵得到平静的行为。受到设计师父亲的熏陶，柏喙所制作的服装贴身舒适，并且具有相当高的观赏水准。只不过在服装元素的设计上，柏喙有时会因难以取舍而过度加入多种元素，使得她的作品整体风格偏向繁复华美，并不那么适用于战斗场合。\n\n干员柏喙本人似乎将替他人设计服装视为情感表达的方式之一，在相处了一段时间后，许多干员都收到了柏喙略带羞赧的测量身体尺寸的请求。

When in areas with no visibility, attacks deal Arts damage=处于<无视野>的区域时，攻击造成法术伤害
When in areas with no visibility, Movement Speed increases=处于<无视野>的区域时，移动速度提升

When not on a mission, La Pluma often heads to the ship's bar - but she goes there not to indulge in drinks, but to mix them.\nWhile in Dossoles, La Pluma worked as a bartender at a small bar, and she brought her craft over to Rhodes Island.\nAs the intersection between the three cultures of Bolívar, Leithanien, and Columbia, Dossoles has provided a variety of rich experiences for La Pluma as she honed her craft, and her bartending has reached quite a high level.\nFurthermore, La Pluma's taciturn nature may normally seem like a character flaw, but as a bartender, the same trait unexpectedly makes her become a good listener. When she first arrived on Rhodes Island, Rose Salt introduced herself with a bevy of cloyingly cute nicknames in order to maintain her cutesy persona. These sickly-sweet names include, but are not limited to, 'Peludita', 'Little Pascy', 'Beautiful Lil' Viper', etc. Many operators, taken in by her charm, starting actually calling her by these names, satisfying her need for cuteness. But after more time together, nearly every operator has learned her true nature, and to get back at her for lying, they started breaking out these cloying nicknames whenever she exposes her true colors, such as when she tries to assert authority over her underlings—\n'Peludita~'\n'Little Pascy~'\n'Beau~ti~ful~ Lil'~ Vi~per~'\n'GAHHH! STOP CALLING ME THAT!'=刚来罗德岛的时候，瑰盐干员为了装可爱，自我介绍的时候会用各种可爱的小昵称来称呼自己，这些甜腻腻的名字包括但不限于“小毛毛”“小帕”“花花蝰”等等等等，不少干员一开始也满怀怜爱地用这些可爱的小昵称来称呼她，满足她提出的各种各样的需求。相处久了，几乎每位干员都知晓了瑰盐的真面目，为了小小地报复一下当初的欺骗，干员们会突然甜腻腻地用这些名字来叫正在凶神恶煞本性毕露处理事情的瑰盐，比如，她正在和手下立威的时候——\n“小毛毛~”\n“小帕~”\n“花~花~蝰~”\n“啊！不许再这么叫我！！！！”

Wild beasts—or rather, things shaped like beasts—are frolicking about the periphery of the Garden. Stone fowl are chased by literal cloudbeasts into the sky, while wooden burdenbeasts chew on fodder as they gaze at the copper fins in the pond. These creatures do not fear humans, some even greeting acquaintances with a nuzzle and a cry for food. Most of your team has been charmed by these friendly creatures. Maybe you can relax a bit too.=一些野兽——或者说形如野兽的东西在界园边隅嬉戏玩闹。石羽被云兽追得四散飞逃，木驮一边嚼着饲料，一边看着池里的铜鳞发呆。这里的生灵都不惧人，有些见着熟人甚至会上前来碰蹭，出声讨食。随员们大多被这些友好的生灵吸引了去，或许你也可以放松一下。

Wild Mane's weapon is a shelled lance, with a unique major/minor-type design. The external fiberglass 'major' is suited for lance charges, the most ideal armament for lance-shock techniques when used appropriately. The interior 'minor' is used for thrusts and stabs in sparring form, suited for close-quarters active combat on the battlefield. Wild Mane duly favors her lance's design, and even though it costs a considerable amount to maintain the major lance after its use, she still insists on using this unique lance she can call her own, and has given nit more painstaking practice than anything else, so that she can show off its mighty ability to impact and batter.=野鬃的武器为单子母骑枪，拥有别致的一母一子式设计。外部玻璃钢材质母枪适于夹枪冲锋，运用得当将是最理想的使用骑枪冲刺技巧的武器。内胆子枪则适用于枪击剑式刺击，适合于战场上近距离的灵活作战。野鬃对自己的武器设计十分青睐，即便母枪在使用后需要耗费不少成本进行维护，她仍坚持使用这把独属于自己的骑枪，并进行了更加刻苦的练习，以便发挥其强大的冲击能力。
